mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage and Slows enemies hit by @SlowPercent*-100@% for 2 seconds.

The area of convergence stays active for @AreaDuration@ seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for @RBuffDuration@ seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.

Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by @ExitSlowPercent*-100@% for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spirit Abjuration</titleLeft><mainText>Aurora will excorcise this unit after 3 Abilities or Attacks!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Damaging an enemy 3 times with Abilities or Attacks exorcises them, dealing <magicDamage>@ProcDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and, if the enemy is a champion, frees a spirit that follows Aurora for @SpiritModeDuration@ seconds, restoring her Health for <healing>@HealCalc@</healing> every second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Damaging an enemy 3 times with Abilities or Attacks exorcises them, dealing @ProcDamage@ max Health magic damage and, if the enemy is a champion, frees a spirit that follows Aurora for @SpiritModeDuration@ seconds, restoring her Health for @HealCalc@ every second.

Max health magic damage is capped at 100-270 against Monsters, based on Aurora's level.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing @damage@ magic damage to enemies and cursing them for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to @Q2DamageMax@ magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%.

If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing @DamageCalc@ magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by @SlowPercent*-100@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ second.

Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Twofold Hex</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is cursed, and will take damage once Aurora ends the curse. Ouch!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Hop in a direction. Upon landing, enter the spirit realm, becoming Invisible for @InvisDuration@ seconds and entering Realm Hopper, gaining @MoveSpeedBonus@% Move Speed.

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this Ability's Cooldown.
